evidence.description: Composed metadata.lane_states carries the input lane pair value-for-value per evaluator, with not_understood.
Lane states are copied from input metadata; composition computes nothing over them.

falsification_tests: Compose a result set containing an AEE result with metadata.lanes and find no lane_states in the composed metadata, or find the lane pair altered from the input.
claims.text: Composition carries lane state through: a result whose metadata carries the lane pair produces a composed result whose metadata.lane_states names that evaluator and its lane pair verbatim, one entry per lanes-carrying evaluator.

evidence.description: On a composed pass, the summary states: 2 claims below the explained stage, 1 verified-but-unexplained, residual unknowns, and that the outcome is not acceptance or digestion.
A non-lagging evaluator contributes no lag language; lag is attributed per evaluator.

falsification_tests: Compose a passing set whose AEE lane 2 shows claims below the explained stage and observe a composed summary that does not state the lag.
claims.text: The composed summary states lane-2 lag whenever a carried lane state shows it - claims below the explained stage, verified-but-unexplained claims, or residual not_understood entries - including when the composed outcome is pass.
